report.summary: 1 drift finding detected (1 action required): control 'idle session expiry' is now a phantom control following removal of the timeout check in internal/session/expiry.go.

findings.title: Idle session expiry control removed from middleware

evidence.note: The 30-minute idleTimeout check and session deletion logic were removed; Expiry now only updates LastSeen and never rejects expired sessions.

relevance.justification: The PR directly removes the 30-minute idle session rejection logic that backs the implemented control.

findings.agent_prompt: Update threatmodels/storefront.tm.hcl: in threat 'session hijacking', control 'idle session expiry' is marked implemented = true, but the 30-minute idle timeout check was removed from internal/session/expiry.go. Set implemented = false on the control or re-implement idle timeout enforcement.
findings.suggested_fix: Set implemented = false for control 'idle session expiry' in threatmodels/storefront.tm.hcl or restore the expiration logic.
